CZ Warns Users to Be Extra Cautious Online in Coming Days Amid PHP Exploits Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) warned users to exercise caution when visiting websites over the coming days, citing two critical PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) affecting servers running popular applications such as WordPress and Magento. The flaws, patched on October 21 after details leaked ahead of disclosure, could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code on vulnerable servers, potentially exposing visitors to credential theft. Exploitation attempts have already been detected, while some website operators may not yet have applied security updates. — link

Bybit Dubai entity secures VASP license from VARA for spot crypto trading Bybit announced on October 22 that its Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, had secured a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) license from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), covering spot crypto trading. Bybit established its international headquarters in Dubai in 2022 and received in-principle approval in 2024. Other exchanges holding VARA licenses include Binance, OKX, Gate and Backpack. — link

CoinDCX Faces Suspected $16 Million Hack After $44 Million Breach in 2025 India's CoinDCX, one of the country's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, may have suffered another security breach, according to on-chain investigator Darcy. On October 21, approximately 15.99 million USDT and 5,784 TRX were transferred from CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a single TRON address, including one transfer of 15.82 million USDT. The funds were subsequently split and routed to deposit addresses at Binance, OKX and Gate. CoinDCX previously lost about $44 million in a July 2025 hack. The latest suspected theft has not been officially confirmed. In response to reports of suspicious outflows, CoinDCX and co-founder Sumit Gupta issued statements assuring users that funds remain safe, asserting that flagged transactions originated from legacy addresses compromised during its July 2025 exploit and abandoned since. Gupta maintained that no active CoinDCX hot wallets were breached and characterized the movement as hackers reusing obsolete addresses. Blockchain investigator ZachXBT swiftly disputed CoinDCX's explanation, providing on-chain evidence showing that the flagged deposit address remained active with a liquidity provider for ten months post-hack, routinely sweeping user deposits and interacting with CoinDCX's current hot wallet as recently as April and May 2026, indicating that roughly $15.8 million in user deposits was unaccounted for by the exchange. CoinDCX has not yet provided further comment. — link

Over 93.5% of Starknet Voting Power Backs Research into Transitioning to Independent Quantum-Resistant Layer 1 Starknet (STRK) tokenholders have approved a research proposal with over 93.5% of voting power supporting an exploration of transitioning Starknet from an Ethereum Layer 2 into an independent, quantum-resistant Layer 1 network. StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November. The vote strictly authorizes preliminary research and does not constitute formal approval of the transition, which will remain subject to a dedicated governance approval process moving forward. — link
